name: float
description: Floating synced-lyrics mini player for Spotify on macOS

scripts.check-env: grep -qE '^SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID=.+' .env 2>/dev/null || { echo 'Missing SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID in .env — copy .env.example to .env and fill it in.' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.build: bun run check-env && bun build ui/ts/main.ts --target=browser --format=esm --minify --env='SPOTIFY_*' --outdir=ui/src/js
scripts.watch: bun run check-env && bun build ui/ts/main.ts --target=browser --format=esm --env='SPOTIFY_*' --outdir=ui/src/js --watch
scripts.dev: bun run build && cd tauri && cargo run
